_comment: Universal Node.js Bot Egg — works with ANY Node.js bot (WhatsApp/Telegram/Discord/Slack/IRC). Auto-detects entry file (index.ts/index.js/bot.ts/bot.js/app.ts/app.js/main.ts/main.js or package.json start script).
name: Universal Node.js Bot
author: Caltex254
description: Universal egg for running ANY Node.js bot — WhatsApp (Baileys / whatsapp-web.js), Telegram (telegraf / node-telegram-bot-api), Discord (discord.js), Slack (slack-sdk), IRC, or any other framework. Auto-detects the entry file (index.ts, index.js, bot.ts, bot.js, app.ts, app.js, main.ts, main.js) or uses package.json 'start' script. Uses Node.js 20 + tsx runtime on Alpine. Auto-restarts on crash with exponential backoff. Just upload your bot files and the egg handles the rest.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
# Universal Node.js Bot - install script
# Files are normally uploaded directly. This is a fallback that downloads the
# universal startup script if missing.
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ ! -f universal-node-start.sh ]; then
    cat > universal-node-start.sh <<'STARTSH'
#!/bin/sh
echo '[install] Placeholder. The real script is shipped with the egg.'
STARTSH
fi
chmod +x universal-node-start.sh
echo '[install] Universal Node.js Bot egg ready.'

variables.name: Startup File (optional)
variables.description: Optional. Override the auto-detected entry file. E.g. 'src/bot.ts' or 'whatsapp-bot.js'. Leave blank to auto-detect.

variables.name: Skip 'npm start'
variables.description: If 'true', ignores package.json 'start' script and uses the auto-detected entry file. Useful when 'start' script does something other than launch the bot.

variables.name: Max Restart Retries
variables.description: Number of times to auto-restart the bot on crash before giving up.

variables.name: Base Restart Delay (seconds)
variables.description: Initial delay between restart attempts. Doubles on each retry (exponential backoff), capped at 300s.
